upper-trishuli-1-rasuwa.conditions_add: IFC said its financing required a Biodiversity Management Plan, finalized before the first disbursement, and monitoring of springs during tunnelling, and its Environmental and Social Action Plan required the company to fund and externally monitor an Indigenous Peoples Plan and to submit the headworks and fish ladder design to the lenders for approval (IFC, Environmental and Social Review Summary). IFC said the project would be run according to its Environmental and Social Performance Standards (IFC).

why.safeguard: required a Biodiversity Management Plan, finalized before the first disbursement

canbalam-barillas.conditions_add: Under its 2008 investment, IFC required CIFI to apply IFC's Performance Standards to all operations it financed and to run an environmental and social management system; amending those procedures was the one environmental and social condition of first disbursement (CAO, 2018 investigation report). The legal agreement also required an annual environmental performance report and notice to IFC within three days of any environmental or social incident (CAO, 2018). After the May 2012 violence the lenders halted disbursements, and in October 2012 CIFI set conditions for further disbursement to Hidro Santa Cruz based on a social risk monitoring report (CAO, 2018).

why.safeguard: IFC required CIFI to apply IFC's Performance Standards to all operations it financed

feronia-phc-palm-oil.conditions_add: The development banks required Feronia and PHC to comply with the IFC Performance Standards and the World Bank Group's environment, health and safety guidelines, and an Environmental and Social Action Plan was drawn up to bring the company into line with Congolese law, those standards and palm oil certification criteria (Human Rights Watch, 2019). The banks did not disclose the specific measures agreed with the company (Human Rights Watch, 2019).

why.safeguard: required Feronia and PHC to comply with the IFC Performance Standards

karachi-brt-red-line-university-road.conditions_add: ADB's project administration manual barred handing over any section for works until compensation at full replacement cost was paid to all affected people and the resettlement plan was completed as verified by an external monitor, and barred contractors from any site until its environmental management plan was approved (ADB, Project Administration Manual). The AIIB loan to Pakistan is sovereign-backed, applies ADB's 2009 Safeguard Policy Statement, and required appointment of safeguards and finance staff acceptable to AIIB and ADB before disbursement (AIIB, project document). All procurement had to follow ADB's procurement policy, with open competitive bidding for works of US$15 million or more (ADB, Project Administration Manual).

why.safeguard: barred handing over any section for works until compensation at full replacement cost was paid
why.repay: The AIIB loan to Pakistan is sovereign-backed

nachtigal-sanaga.conditions_add: Under the IBRD guarantees, Cameroon signed an Indemnity Agreement giving the World Bank the right to require the government to reimburse it immediately on demand for any amount it paid out; the guarantees backed the government's payments under the power purchase agreement and its duty to buy local loans if lenders used put options (World Bank, Project Appraisal Document, 2018). The guarantees took effect only once full construction financing, all project agreements and host country environmental approvals were in place, and the project company agreed to comply with the World Bank Performance Standards (World Bank, PAD). The lenders later required a binding Supplementary Corrective Action Plan with time-bound actions (World Bank Inspection Panel, 2022).

why.repay: right to require the government to reimburse it immediately on demand
why.safeguard: the project company agreed to comply with the World Bank Performance Standards

kampala-lubigi-kawaala.conditions_add: The 2014 credit required Uganda to deposit 2.98 billion shillings (about US$1.19 million) into a project escrow account for resettlement compensation as a condition for the credit to take effect, and to keep the account until needed for those payments (World Bank, Project Appraisal Document, 2014). The appraisal document also said resettlement plans must be done before sub-projects begin and that land could be taken for project work only after compensation was paid (World Bank, PAD, 2014). The same project set a target of at least a 15 percent yearly rise in the city authority's own revenue (World Bank, PAD, 2014).
